issues.t: Automatic transmission shifts erratically with O/D OFF light flashing
issues.sym: The automatic shifts harshly or at odd times, gets stuck in second or third gear, slips, or revs without accelerating, while the O/D OFF light flashes and the check engine light may come on.
issues.why: Mazda issued bulletins for this. On 1997-1998 models a pinched wiring harness to the transmission fluid temperature sensor can cause it, and on 1999-2000 models the transmission can stop upshifting because of a fault in its control system. Worn transmissions also slip.
issues.next: Have the transmission codes read before agreeing to a rebuild; a wiring repair or sensor may fix it. Check the fluid level and condition too.

issues.t: Ignition switch can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from the steering column, accessories that cut in and out, or in the worst case a fire, even while the car is parked.
issues.why: Grease inside the ignition switch can break down and start conducting electricity, which can overheat the switch. Mazda recalled these cars in 2015 and replaces the switch for free.
issues.next: Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a Mazda dealer and get the free switch replacement. If you smell burning near the steering column, stop using the car until it is fixed.

issues.t: Alternator or voltage regulator failure
issues.sym: Battery light on, dim or flickering lights, a battery that keeps going dead, or a car that stalls while driving.
issues.why: The voltage regulator built into the alternator can fail and overcharge or undercharge, which can also ruin the battery. Alternator failures are among the most reported repairs on this car.
issues.next: Have the battery and charging system tested. If the alternator is overcharging, replace it before it kills a new battery.

issues.t: Front brake calipers stick
issues.sym: The car pulls to one side when braking, a burning smell or hot wheel after driving, grinding, or pads wearing out quickly on one side.
issues.why: Front calipers corrode and stick, so the pads keep rubbing. This is the most-reported problem on 2002 Proteges and the top repair in owner surveys.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected. A sticking caliper should be replaced with new pads, and the brake fluid flushed if it is old.

issues.t: Broken engine mounts
issues.sym: Heavy vibration at idle, a clunk when shifting into drive or reverse, or a jolt when you step on the gas.
issues.why: The rubber engine mounts crack and wear out with age, letting the engine move too much.
issues.next: Have the mounts checked. A broken mount is not an emergency but it strains other parts, so replace it soon.

issues.t: Clunk over bumps from worn struts or stabilizer links
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the front or rear when going over bumps, and a bouncy or floaty ride.
issues.why: Struts, stabilizer bar end links and bushings wear out and are among the most common repairs on this car. Mazda also issued a bulletin for a rear stabilizer bar clunk on 2001-2002 models.
issues.next: Have the suspension inspected. End links and bushings are cheap fixes; worn struts should be replaced in pairs.

issues.t: Wheel bearing hum
issues.sym: A humming or growling noise that gets louder with speed and may change when you turn.
issues.why: Wheel bearings and hub assemblies wear out; owners report them often on the Protege.
issues.next: Have it checked soon. A badly worn bearing can overheat and fail.

issues.t: Hesitation and jerking when accelerating
issues.sym: The car hesitates, bucks or jerks when you accelerate, may feel down on power, and the check engine light may show lean codes such as P0171.
issues.why: Mazda issued bulletins for lack of power with lean-running codes and for hesitation and jerking on these years. Cracked intake air hoses, which let in unmeasured air, can cause the same symptoms.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the intake hoses checked for cracks. Ask a dealer about the related bulletins and software.

issues.t: Misfire from a failed ignition coil
issues.sym: Rough running, shaking at idle, loss of power and a flashing or steady check engine light.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin about ignition coil failures on the 1.8L engine. Coil packs are a common Protege repair.
issues.next: Have the misfire codes read. Do not drive far with a flashing check engine light, as it can damage the catalytic converter.

issues.t: Check engine light from an EGR fault (P0402)
issues.sym: Check engine light with code P0402 (too much exhaust gas recirculation), sometimes with rough idle.
issues.why: Mazda issued bulletins for check engine lights with code P0402 on these years. EGR valves are also a common replacement on this car.
issues.next: Have the EGR valve and its passages checked and cleaned. Ask a dealer about the bulletin repair.

issues.t: High idle with check engine light (P0507)
issues.sym: The engine idles too fast, often revving high right after starting, with a check engine light and code P0507.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin for code P0507 (idle speed higher than expected) on 2001-2003 Proteges. Dirty idle air control parts or vacuum leaks are common causes.
issues.next: Have the idle air control valve and throttle body cleaned and check for vacuum leaks.

issues.t: Hard starting
issues.sym: The engine cranks longer than normal before it starts, especially when cold or after sitting.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin for hard starting on these model years.
issues.next: Have fuel pressure, spark and sensors checked, and ask the dealer about the bulletin fix.

issues.t: Rattle from the engine when cold
issues.sym: A rattle from the engine area between about 1,000 and 3,000 rpm when the engine is cold.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin for this cold-engine rattle on 2001-2002 Proteges. Loose heat shields are another common source of rattles.
issues.next: Have a shop pin down the source. If it fades as the engine warms up and nothing is loose, it is usually not serious.

issues.t: Rear brake hose damaged at the factory (recall)
issues.sym: Brake fluid leaking near the left rear wheel, a soft or sinking brake pedal, or a brake warning light.
issues.why: Some left rear brake hoses were damaged during assembly and can leak, reducing braking. Mazda recalled affected cars to inspect and replace the hose.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. Any brake fluid leak needs fixing before you drive.

issues.t: Water can short the radio and overheat a speaker (recall)
issues.sym: The radio cuts out or smokes, or the right rear speaker gets hot, usually in hot, humid weather with the A/C running.
issues.why: Water condensing in the A/C duct can drip onto the factory radio and short it, which can overheat a speaker and in rare cases start a fire. Mazda recalled about 23,000 early 1999 Proteges.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. The fix is free.

issues.t: Radiator or water pump leak
issues.sym: Coolant puddles under the front of the car, a sweet smell, the temperature gauge climbing, or low coolant.
issues.why: The radiator, water pump and thermostat are common cooling system repairs on the Protege as it ages.
issues.next: Do not drive if the engine overheats. Have the cooling system pressure tested to find the leak.

issues.t: Oil leak from the valve cover gasket
issues.sym: Oil on the top or side of the engine, a burning oil smell, or oil in the spark plug wells causing a misfire.
issues.why: The valve cover gasket and spark plug tube seals harden with age and leak.
issues.next: Replace the gasket and seals; it is a fairly cheap job.

issues.t: Blower fan works only on high
issues.sym: The heater and A/C fan works only on the highest setting, or not at all.
issues.why: The blower motor resistor, which controls the lower fan speeds, burns out.
issues.next: Replace the blower motor resistor; it is usually an easy, cheap part.

issues.t: Body rust
issues.sym: Bubbling paint and rust, often around the rear wheel arches and lower body.
issues.why: Rust is a known weak spot on this generation, especially in states that salt the roads.
issues.next: Treat small spots early. Have the underbody and brake lines checked for rust on older cars.

issues.t: Power door locks or door key cylinder fail
issues.sym: Power locks work only some of the time, or the key is hard to put in or turn in the door or trunk lock.
issues.why: Mazda issued bulletins for power door lock malfunctions and for door and trunk lock cylinders whose flaps break or bind.
issues.next: A shop can replace the lock actuator or lock cylinder. Ask a dealer about the related bulletins.

issues.t: Rotten egg smell from the exhaust
issues.sym: A sulfur or rotten egg smell from the exhaust, mostly after hard acceleration or a long drive.
issues.why: The catalytic converter can turn sulfur in gasoline into a smelly gas. Mazda has bulletins on this odor, and a failing catalytic converter can make it worse.
issues.next: Try a different brand of gas. If the smell is strong or the check engine light is on, have the converter and fuel mixture checked.

issues.t: Musty smell from the A/C vents
issues.sym: A musty or mildew smell when the A/C first comes on.
issues.why: Mold grows on the damp A/C evaporator. Mazda issued bulletins on this.
issues.next: Have the evaporator cleaned and replace the cabin filter if fitted. Running the fan without A/C before parking helps.

issues.t: Clunk or thump from the rear suspension
issues.sym: A clunk or thump from the rear of the car when driving over bumps.
issues.why: Mazda issued bulletins for a rear suspension clunk over bumps and a thumping noise from the rear suspension tower on these years.
issues.next: Have the rear struts, mounts and bushings checked. It is usually not a safety issue.

issues.t: Popping from the front brakes at low speed
issues.sym: A pop or click from the front brakes when braking gently at low speed.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin for a popping noise from the front brake calipers during slow-speed braking.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected; lubricating or replacing the caliper slides and pad hardware usually fixes it.

issues.t: Brake warning light stays on
issues.sym: The red brake warning light stays on even with the parking brake released.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin for this on these years. A low brake fluid level from worn pads or a leak can also turn the light on.
issues.next: Check the brake fluid level first. If it is low, have the brakes checked for wear or a leak before driving far.

issues.t: Weak heat or slow engine warm-up
issues.sym: The heater blows lukewarm air and the temperature gauge takes a long time to rise.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin for weak heat and slow warm-up. A thermostat stuck open is the usual cause.
issues.next: Have the thermostat replaced. It also helps fuel economy and keeps the engine at the right temperature.

issues.t: A/C stops working with check engine light on
issues.sym: The A/C will not turn on and the check engine light is lit.
issues.why: Mazda issued bulletins for an inoperative A/C with the check engine light on, and for corrosion on the power steering pressure switch that can upset the A/C.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the A/C and power steering switches checked before replacing the compressor.

issues.t: Noise from the drive shafts
issues.sym: A clicking, knocking or humming noise from the front axles, often when turning or accelerating.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin for drive shaft noise on these years. Worn CV joints are a common cause.
issues.next: Check the CV boots for tears and grease. A clicking joint should be replaced before it fails.

issues.t: Poor engine performance
issues.sym: The engine feels weak, hesitates or runs poorly.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin for poor engine performance on these years.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a dealer about the bulletin repair. Also check the spark plugs, wires and air filter.

issues.t: Check engine light from the EGR sensor circuit (P0400)
issues.sym: Check engine light with code P0400 under certain loads and speeds.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin saying electrical noise in the EGR boost sensor circuit can set this code on 1995-1996 Proteges.
issues.next: Ask a shop to check the EGR sensor wiring and the bulletin repair before replacing the EGR valve.
